notice: Closer de base, profil gauche, inclinaison vers l’avant et deux bras-colonnes placés en décalé. Les deux jambes centrales fines et sombres touchent le sol. Il s’agit d’une pose au repos réinterprétée depuis les références sources, pas d’une animation.

references.note: Strongly foreshortened ambiguous model render. A long mass at image lower left is an arm column, not a flesh-coloured booted leg. Dark thin central limbs are partially hidden. Use gameplay captures for limb topology; model only for surface bands, texture and pose context.
references.sourceType: Original Silent Hill 3 (2003) model render or gameplay screenshot, archived by Silent Hill Memories.

references.note: Genuine independent rear/three-quarter in-game pose beside Heather in normal mall. Lower arms/feet extend to or beyond frame bottom, so incomplete full-body silhouette and no measured scale.

references.note: Genuine front game view clearly shows TWO massive lateral hanging arm columns, a small elongated head and TWO narrow dark central legs under apron. Heather/muzzle flash obscure feet and portions of legs. Do not turn an arm column into a flesh-coloured booted leg. Still image, no timing measurement.

notice: Double Head original, profil droit. Nuque tendue, avant-train abaissé, quatre pattes au sol, arrière-train bandé relevé et museau fermé laissant une ligne de séparation. La pose de garde est recomposée, distincte de la course en trois quarts du portrait historique.

references.note: Canine quadruped, bandaged arched body, single cleft head/two jaw structures on one neck. Four limbs, far front paw lifted. Not two separately necked dog heads.
